# Scyphe and Cruz

Cruz are on **Diamond_sword**

![Cruz](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/57a623ed912eed3dd9428bbb211068d8f954c982.png)

![Scyphe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2336ed47d117c59599e5cc985e332d75728bfcb1.png)

# **How to make on head with command :**

_/item replace entity {Name} armor.head from entity {Name} weapon_

## **Or give :**

_/give @p iron_sword[equippable={slot:"head"}]_
